|game_text=If [Virtual Block 7] [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed{{!}}Rebel Strike Team]] on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each of your non-Jedi scouts at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. Once per turn may ▲ Bunker. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[The Shield Is Down! (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]; it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints it.
* '''Original''' ([[The Shield Is Down! (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; this copy was re-made on 25 July 2011, after the errata of 23 June 2011; the first printing has not been found), page 6, slip 36 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If [Virtual Block 7] Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each non-Jedi scout at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. May ▲ Bunker. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p6-117-The_Shield_Is_Down.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Shield Is Down! (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013; the ▲ written out as “take Bunker into hand from Reserve Deck; Reshuffle”) adds “Once per turn” to the last sentence<ref name="cl-1273_36-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “If [Virtual Block 7] Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each non-Jedi scout at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. Once per turn may ▲ Bunker. [Immune to Alter]” Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A gives the same text (written without the icons).<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-21; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-p6-117-The_Shield_Is_Down-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 13 January 2012, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p674028">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 13 January 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p674028 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) has “for each of your non-Jedi scouts at Bunker” instead of “for each non-Jedi scout at Bunker”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30, page 30. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If [Virtual Block 7] Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each of your non-Jedi scouts at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. Once per turn may ▲ Bunker. [Immune to Alter]” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-theshieldisdown-pre.gif]]) prints it. The Players Committee announced this text on 19 October 2012, effective immediately (“replaces all previous errata for this card”)<ref name="pcforum-p761411">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 October 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p761411 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
